name: QuicksilverOne Cash Rewards
balance_transfer_fee: $0 at the standard Transfer APR, or 4% at any promotional APR Capital One may offer

verdict.text: Same earn rate as the free Quicksilver: graduate once your score allows

earn_rates.category: Hotels, vacation rentals & rental cars, via Capital One Travel

earn_note: QuicksilverOne earns what the no-fee Quicksilver earns: 1.5% flat plus 5% on Capital One Travel and Capital One Entertainment bookings. The entire premium here is credit access (approvals down to fair credit), not a richer rewards rate; there's no intro APR.

redemption_options.method: Statement credit, check, or gift cards

points.note: Same flat 1¢-per-point cash back as Quicksilver, with no minimum redemption and no expiration while the account is open. The $39 annual fee doesn't buy a better rate, only easier approval.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer currency: straight cash back only.

insurance.detail: Doubles warranties of ≤24 months, adding up to 24 further months
Up to $1M · when fare is charged to the card
$1,500 per insured person on non-refundable common carrier tickets
Delay $100/day up to $300 · lost luggage $1,500/incident (Mastercard) or $3,000/trip (Discover)

protection_note: Capital One's materials don't call out any protection differences from the no-fee Quicksilver. Expect purchase protection, extended warranty, price protection, trip cancellation and interruption up to $1,500 per person, baggage delay and lost luggage cover, and no trip delay, emergency medical or cell phone cover. Limits differ between the Mastercard and Discover versions, so check your own Guide to Benefits.
rental_note: Secondary auto rental collision/theft coverage, up to 31 days, pays out after your personal auto policy. Decline the counter's CDW/LDW and charge the entire rental to this card to activate it; excludes trucks, vans, off-road and sport utility trucks, motorbikes and anything with fewer than four wheels, plus commercial or for-hire use.

services.name: No intro APR
services.detail: Unlike Quicksilver, there's no 0% introductory period. A variable 29.24% APR applies to purchases, balance transfers, and cash advances from day one.

services.name: Automatic credit line review
services.detail: Capital One automatically considers cardholders for a higher credit line in as little as 6 months, the main reason to hold this card at all.

services.name: Complimentary concierge
services.detail: 24/7, 365-day concierge for dining, entertainment, and travel arrangements.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Earns cash back on their spend (into your account)
Same purchase protection as the primary card

additional_cards.note: Free to add: useful for building a trusted household member's credit history alongside your own.

timeline.text: Reported by third parties, with no Capital One document found: select Quicksilver and QuicksilverOne accounts moving to the Discover network, adding 3% at grocery stores and gas stations.
Capital One completes its acquisition of Discover Financial Services, setting up the network migration above.
